name: Provider badge
summary: A provider's name with its logo. Logos are swappable files with their source and permission recorded; until a provider's permission is, the badge shows a plain initial.

when: Wherever a provider is named: account rows, the provider page header, choosing a provider.

anatomy.description: The logo, an initial, or a globe for an address someone typed.

props.name: provider
props.description: A known provider's id, such as bluesky, or an address someone typed.

props.name: name
props.description: The name to show, if it's not a known provider's.

props.name: label
props.description: Text to show instead of the name, such as “Hosted by Bluesky”.

states.name: Logo
states.description: The provider's logo, when its permission is recorded.

states.name: No logo yet
states.description: A plain tile with the provider's initial.

states.name: Typed address
states.description: A globe, for a provider someone typed in.

accessibility.name: None.
screenReader: Read as the provider's name; the tile is decorative.

guidelines: Use the provider's own name, such as Bluesky.

dosAndDonts.do: Use a provider's logo only with its permission recorded.
dosAndDonts.dont: Draw or approximate a provider's logo.

evidence.point: Real names and logos, kept as swappable files with their source and permission (decision in #1).
